name: Sage Varela
source:
Favorite food: Black coffee (he says) (it's actually French toast)
Favorite horror movie: Hellraiser
Worst habit: Sleeps with jeans on

A third-year art history major at Kettleboro University. He plays cameraman to his idiot friends' paranormal hijinks, but he doesn't actually believe in ghosts.

He's rather be working on his next masterpiece: a poster that Really Makes You Think.

[From [url=https://greensolid.tumblr.com/post/176991761152/meet-the-player-character-of-west-falls-sage]Tumblr[/url]]
